title: HIVE Zero-Trust Swarm Invariants
hook: Preventing monotonic entropy degradation in autonomous agent loops.
core_insight: Agent ensembles processing untrusted external tool outputs experience state drift. Gating transitions with deterministic policy contracts ensures system state remains inside verifiable bounds.
takeaways: Enforce N >= 3f + 1 consensus bounds on privileged commands.
Decouple the reasoning plane from deterministic policy execution.
